scope: Static package audit for the selected ten archive outputs. No gameplay or browser QA was performed.

method.artifactChecks: Compared each source-manifest file against on-disk presence, byte size, and SHA-256; reconciled file counts and artifact byte totals.
method.referenceChecks: Inspected entry HTML, CSS, runtime bootstrap code, and static local asset references. Treated conditional SDK, platform, and user-triggered download references separately from core runtime assets.
method.encoding: All pinned output files in this batch record identity wire and artifact encodings. No compressed Unity payload was successfully included.
method.httpHeaders: Not verified. A bounded localhost request was refused by the local dev listener, so Content-Type and Content-Encoding response headers remain unconfirmed.
method.gameplayQA: Not performed; left to the user per recovery instructions.

batchIntegrity.note: These checks establish integrity of files that were packaged; they do not establish that optional or undiscovered runtime dependencies are complete.

blockingIssues: The entry config declares a Unity 2020.3.37f1 build with cached decompressed payloads of about 33 MB. The package has only 105,621 artifact bytes and omits FunnyShooter2_Poki.data.unityweb, framework.js.unityweb, loader.js, wasm.unityweb, and the configured game JPEG; the manifest records 404s for these paths. master-loader.js and unity-2020.js alone are only loaders, not the game runtime payload.
packages.action: Recover and hash-pin the Unity data, framework, loader, wasm, and referenced image files before integration.

blockingIssues: Construct 3 main.js explicitly configures engineScripts [scripts/c3runtime.js], but c3runtime.js is absent. workermain.js and box2d.wasm.js are also missing; the source manifest records 404s. The presence of main.js is not a complete Construct runtime.
packages.action: Recover the pinned Construct runtime and required worker dependencies, then repeat the reference and hash audit.

blockingIssues: Construct 3 main.js explicitly requests scripts/c3runtime.js, which is absent. workermain.js is also missing. The packaged opus wasm files do not replace the Construct runtime core.
packages.action: Recover c3runtime.js and worker dependencies before integration.

nonBlockingIssues: index.html references manifest.json and ../favicon.png, neither is packaged; these are PWA/icon references.
The packaged Latin PT Sans WOFF2 file is a 97-byte plain-text 'No Content' placeholder, and the other font slices return 404; expect fallback typography until valid font files are pinned.
The loader includes Google/Input Tools references that the archive CSP will block. No external calls were enabled or bypassed; gameplay/network behavior still needs the user's manual QA.
packages.action: For a polished package, repair the font references and either add manifest/icon files or remove only the non-core references after review. Preserve the archive CSP.

blockingIssues: The Cocos settings declare hasResourcesBundle=true and launchScene=db://assets/loadBundle.fire, but the package contains no assets/resources bundle, scene, or bundle manifest. The 1.86 MB cocos2d-js file is the engine; settings and the small 27.6 KB main script do not provide the game scene/content.
packages.action: Recover and pin the Cocos main/resources bundle and launch scene. Physics files are conditional and are not the primary blocker.

nonBlockingIssues: The Fancade shell references ancillary common/view files and sound assets that returned 404; the packaged index.wasm and index.data game payloads are present.
packages.action: Static package is suitable for user gameplay QA. Check the archive host serves index.wasm as application/wasm and the data file without an incorrect Content-Encoding before promotion.

nonBlockingIssues: The GameMaker core and three texture atlases are packaged. YaGames adapter code attempts to load relative sdk.js, which is absent; the archive CSP also blocks external SDK/network calls. The game code repeatedly checks SDK initialization, so user QA must confirm it reaches its normal start state without the publisher SDK.
packages.action: Integrate only as a static QA candidate under the existing CSP. Do not inject a fake SDK or bypass the CSP; resolve publisher SDK availability or confirm graceful behavior before release.

nonBlockingIssues: GameMaker runtime and both texture atlases are packaged. The Poki adapter is included as a file but not referenced by the entry HTML; the inline bootstrap falls back to GameMaker_Init when PokiSDK is unavailable. Publisher services remain blocked by archive CSP.
packages.action: Static package is suitable for user gameplay QA; keep publisher services blocked and do not claim gameplay verified.

blockingIssues: The compiled OpenFL/Lime script embeds an asset manifest whose libraryArgs name lib/default.pak with gzip packing, but no lib/default.pak or other asset pack is present. The manifest also records 404s for game-config/assets references. The 4.6 MB JavaScript bootstrap alone is not the packaged game content.
packages.action: Recover and hash-pin the referenced packed asset library (and validate its compression handling) before integration.

nonBlockingIssues: The bundle contains the START/MIDDLE/FINISH level JSON modules inline; the 115 missing level-JSON URLs reported by the broad static scanner are bundled module names, not absent files required by the loader.
26 seasonal shop, character thumbnail, popup, and shadow images returned 404; core bundle and startup assets are present, but those cosmetics may display missing-image placeholders.
Poki/ad/social endpoints are external and remain blocked by archive CSP.
packages.action: Static package is suitable for user gameplay QA. Confirm missing cosmetic images fail gracefully; keep external publisher services blocked.

releaseReadiness: No package is declared playable or production-ready by this audit. The candidate list means asset-level static integration and user QA can proceed; it does not record successful gameplay or SDK/WebGL QA.
